name: Click Indicator
description: Shows a macro's clicks as osu!mania-style bars in the level and a rhythm lane.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the whole mod on or off.

menu-key.name: Menu Hotkey
menu-key.description: Key that opens the Click Indicator menu from anywhere, even mid-level (the level pauses). You can also use the button in the pause menu.

overlay-key.name: Overlay Hotkey
overlay-key.description: Toggles the whole indicator on/off without opening the menu.

assist-key.name: Aim Assist Hotkey
assist-key.description: Toggles the aim assist on/off without opening the menu.

per-level.name: Remember Settings Per Level
per-level.description: Keeps the menu settings (enabled, lane, bars, judgments, assist and strengths) separately for every level.

macro-folder.name: Macro Folder
macro-folder.description: Put macro files here. A file is used automatically when its name matches the <cy>level ID</c> or <cy>level name</c> (for example <cg>12345.gdr</c> or <cg>Bloodbath.gdr.json</c>).

macro-file.name: Fallback Macro File
macro-file.description: Used when no file in the macro folder matches the level. Supports <cg>.gdr</c>, <cg>.gdr.json</c>, <cg>.gdr2</c> and JSON macros.

offset-ms.name: Timing Offset (ms)
offset-ms.description: Shifts every click earlier (negative) or later (positive) if the bars look slightly off.

show-bars.name: Show Click Bars
show-bars.description: Green bars in the level where each click happens. Thin line = tap, wide bar = hold.

show-hit-line.name: Show Hit Line
show-hit-line.description: The vertical line that follows the player.

show-markers.name: Show Click Markers
show-markers.description: Small squares on each bar at the player's height.

hide-passed.name: Hide Passed Clicks
hide-passed.description: Only draw clicks that are still ahead of the player.

hide-after-percent.name: Hide Overlay After %
hide-after-percent.description: Hides the whole indicator once you pass this percent, to test whether you've learned the clicks. 0 = never.

trouble-spots.name: Trouble Spots
trouble-spots.description: Clicks you keep getting wrong across attempts turn red. Hitting them well again clears the red.

trouble-threshold.name: Trouble Spot Threshold
trouble-threshold.description: How many bad attempts (late, early or missed) before a click turns red.

assist-enabled.name: Aim Assist
assist-enabled.description: If you click <cy>early</c>, the click is held back and sent at the exact moment the macro clicked. Late clicks go through normally. At strength <cg>5</c> and up, letting go early does not end the hold: it keeps holding until the macro lets go.

assist-strength.name: Assist Strength
assist-strength.description: How early you can be and still get lined up. <cg>1</c> = 1 ms, <cg>5</c> = about 22 ms, <cg>7</c> = 100 ms, <cr>10</c> = a full second.

assist-safe-mode.name: Safe Mode With Assist
assist-safe-mode.description: While aim assist is on, the level runs like a start-pos test, so no percentage or completion is saved.

assist-release-strength.name: Release Strength
assist-release-strength.description: Separate strength for letting go. <cg>0</c> = same as the press strength. 5 and up: an early release never ends the hold.

assist-off-percent.name: Assist Off After %
assist-off-percent.description: The assist turns itself off once you pass this percent, so the ending is all you. 0 = never.

assist-flash.name: Flash When Assist Kicks In
assist-flash.description: Flashes the lane receptor yellow and shows ASSIST when a click was corrected.

show-lane.name: Show Rhythm Lane
show-lane.description: The osu!mania-style lane on the side of the screen.

lane-lookahead.name: Lane Look-Ahead (seconds)
lane-lookahead.description: How far ahead the lane shows notes. Lower = faster scrolling.

lane-gap.name: Player 2 Lane Gap
lane-gap.description: Extra space between the two lanes in 2-player levels.

show-judgments.name: Show Timing Judgments
show-judgments.description: Compares your clicks to the macro and shows PERFECT / GREAT / GOOD / MISS with the offset in milliseconds.

tick-sound.name: Click Sounds
tick-sound.description: Plays a tick at every macro press, like a metronome.

tick-release.name: Tick On Releases Too
tick-release.description: Also plays a softer tick where holds let go.

stats-on-death.name: Short Stats On Death
stats-on-death.description: A one-line accuracy summary each time you die (normal mode).

record-info.description: Turn on <cy>Recording</c> in the in-game menu (Tools page), play in practice mode to 100%, and your clicks are saved as a macro named after the level.
